_comment: Scoped 2026-11-04 help/access/export correction; not product execution or full terms review.

axes.model_access: Official help describes Gemini capabilities; account-specific model choices were not checked.
axes.runtime: Browser and mobile help are separate. The 2026-11-04 check covers browser access conditions, without installation or sign-in.
axes.local_files: Official help lists PDF, web, YouTube, audio and Google Docs/Slides sources; check current limits and account scope.
axes.background: Official help lists generated formats including audio overviews; queuing, background duration and recovery were not checked.
axes.tools: Source-grounded Q&A and note organization coexist with source discovery. Check answering and discovery separately; uploaded-only claims are too broad.
axes.context: Notebooks organize sources and notes; cross-notebook state, memory and exact limits were not checked.
axes.permissions: Google sign-in is required; organization access, region and age conditions apply. Check data use by account and feedback context, rather than turning older FAQ wording into an unconditional training guarantee.
axes.fit: Use for sourced Q&A, notes and research organization. Check retrieval coverage, answer support and generated content separately. A failed connection is not national reachability evidence; citation markers are not accuracy guarantees.

runs: Scoped documentation check on 2026-11-04: help naming, browser access, grounded answering/source discovery and Export to Docs. Two help sources were added. No sign-in, installation, retrieval/audio test, current-price review, full-contract review or nationwide reachability check was performed. Older terms/update links retain their 2026-10-22 scope.
unknowns:
- Actual account migration, model choices and quotas
- Mobile availability for a specific region/device
- Organization contracts, feedback-related data use and full retention terms
- Retrieval coverage, long-document handling, audio quality and task recovery (not executed)
related: Same vendor; compare task and account scope rather than inferring coverage from branding.
For papers, inspect scholarly retrieval; check coverage separately from extraction.
Inspect another retrieval entry point; check language, sources, region and access separately.
